name: World Central Kitchen
summary: A US charity founded by the chef José Andrés that cooks and delivers hot meals after disasters and in wars, through its own field kitchens, local restaurants and food trucks: in 2025 mostly in Gaza, then Haiti, Ukraine, Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa, Myanmar after the earthquake, and US disasters such as the Los Angeles fires and the Texas floods.

lines.label: Emergency relief programs (meals in disasters and wars)
lines.source: https://wck.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/FY2025-World-Central-Kitchen-Financial-Statements.pdf (year to 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of activities p. 6 and functional expenses p. 8): Program 372,535,106, the charity's only programme (Emergency Relief Programs). One model with three branches by place, split by the Form 990's Schedule F regions.
